attempts.summary: Created an LVM logical volume (vgdata/lvdata) on node1, backed by two loopback-file physical volumes since no spare block device existed, formatted ext4 and mounted it at /srv/data. Wrote test data, then grew the LV online (while mounted) from ~1000MiB to ~2.15GiB via vgextend + lvextend + resize2fs, verifying data integrity throughout. Set up persistence across reboot via a systemd oneshot unit (lvm-loopback.service) that reattaches the loop devices and activates the VG before local-fs-pre.target, referenced from /etc/fstab via x-systemd.requires. Performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured baseline boot_id and healthy mount/data state, issued systemctl reboot, polled until exec was available again, confirmed boot_id changed, and verified /srv/data remounted automatically at 2.1G with both test files passing sha256sum verification.
